info.cls_ename: Department of Foreign Languages and Literature

description.describe_ch: 西班牙文會話課程旨在藉由日常生活相關之主題或情境，進行對話及字彙演練；上課方式以兩人或小組練習對話，以培養出學生具有基礎西語會話能力。主題包含家庭、旅遊、人物描繪、採買或用餐等。
description.describe_eh: This course aims to help students build their basic speaking and listening skills by applying daily-life vocabulary to situational dialogues. Topics include introducing family, planning trips, describing people, buying groceries, going to restaurants, etc. In the meantime, pair work and group work are essential to the classroom activities.

targets.describe_ch: 具備英/外文聽、說、讀、寫的應用能力
targets.describe_en: To be equipped with the  listening, speaking, reading and writing abilities of the target language

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. 上課請準時出席，上課遲到超過二十分鐘者以缺席一節計。
  連續遲到三次計缺席一節。
  缺課達該科實際授課總時數1/2者(不含期中考試週與期末考試週)，該科目學期成績零分計算。
2. 作業準時繳交，逾時每日扣五分。
3. 平時考試請假者須於到校後立即找老師補考，考卷發回後一律不接受補考，隨堂考試不得補考。
4.上課時手機務必關機。
5.課程內容與進度如有異動，依授課教師課堂宣佈為準。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
1.  Please attend class on time. Arriving more than 20 minutes late will be considered as one absence.
2. Three late arrivals will count as one absence.
     If absences exceed half of the total actual teaching hours for the course (excluding midterm and final exam weeks), the semester grade for the course will be calculated as zero.
3. Submit assignments on time. Late submissions will incur a penalty of 5 points per day.
4. Students who are absent during regular exams must make arrangements with the teacher to take a makeup exam immediately upon returning to school. Makeup exams will not be allowed after the graded exam papers have been distributed. and In-class quizzes cannot be retaken.
5. Phones must be turned off during class.
6. Any changes to course content or schedule will be based on announcements made by the instructor in class.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
支持使用正版課本，以維護作者的智慧財產權。
學生將藉由課本，以循序漸進的方式，針對日常生活不同的主題，進行模擬情狀的對話練習。
凡是學生曲解自己的學習任務、或損害學術任務之不端正行為，包括在作業或考試中作弊、剽竊、竄改；或將他人完成的作品作為自己的作品；或未經教師批准和同意，提交相似的報告等，被認定有學術不端的行為，學生的學業成績將扣分，並依本校學生獎懲辦法提報處分。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: • Foundation of Integrity Learning must be built upon a foundation of integrity. Any attempt by a student to present work they did not create as their own is considered a dishonest act. Cheating or plagiarizing others’ work during assignments, quizzes, or exams—as well as providing unauthorized assistance to others—will result in a score of zero for that specific task.
